title: Release that Witch
description: Roland, a modern man reborn as a prince in the dangerous Border Town, rescues the witches Anna and Nana Pine from the Church. Harnessing their extraordinary powers, he fuses magic and technology to craft weapons, armies, and steam engines to defend his people. As the Demon Moon rises and conspiracies close in on his family, Roland must lead a revolution to protect his allies and reshape the world.

episodes_data.title: Release that Witch Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: Roland Wimbledon is the 4th Prince of Graycastle and halts the execution of Anna, a recently discovered witch.

episodes_data.title: Release that Witch Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: Roland asks Anna to help him create a new world that isn't bound by the Church, where witches can live freely.

episodes_data.title: Release that Witch Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: Roland recruits Karl to build a wall that can withstand the demonic beasts, and meets Nana, another witch.
